sloka: घन उपगूढम् गगनम् न तारान भास्करो दर्शनम् अभ्युपैति ।नवैः जल ओघैः धरणी वितृप्तातमो विलिप्ता न दिशः प्रकाशाः ॥४-२८-४७॥
transliteration: ghana upagūḍham gaganam na tārāna bhāskaro darśanam abhyupaiti ।navaiḥ jala oghaiḥ dharaṇī vitṛptātamo viliptā na diśaḥ prakāśāḥ ॥4-28-47॥

translations.english: 'Ennveloped by clouds, the Sun and stars are not visible. The earth glides with the flow of fresh waters. The directions are not clear, covered by darkness.
